title: uMihlali uyadanisa!
description: Usuku lomboniso omkhulu wasesikolweni lwalusondele, kwaye uMihlali wayephelile luvalo. Uyoze akwazi ukudanisa esidlangalaleni, onke amehlo ejonge ntsho kuye?
